methods.name: PI-GANO
methods.protocol_description: Physics-Informed Geometry-Aware Neural Operator combining a geometry encoder with Deep Compositional Operator Network (DCON) architecture. Trained with physics-informed loss using PDE residual and boundary conditions, without FEM data. Uses Tanh activation, three operator layers of width 512, Adam optimizer (β1=0.9, β2=0.999), grid search over learning rates {0.001,0.0005,0.0002,0.0001} and coordinate sampling ratios {0.3,0.2,0.1,0.05}. Batch size 20, trained on NVIDIA P100 GPU.

methods.name: PI-DCON
methods.protocol_description: Physics-informed Deep Compositional Operator Network, baseline method. Uses three operator layers of width 512, Tanh activation, Adam optimizer, same hyperparameter grid search as PI-GANO.

methods.name: PI-PointNet
methods.protocol_description: Physics-informed PointNet, baseline method. Uses three hidden layers of width 512, Tanh activation, Adam optimizer, same hyperparameter grid search. Original version lacks PDE parameter generalization.

methods.name: PI-PointNet*
methods.protocol_description: Modified PI-PointNet with PDE parameter encoding by concatenating parameter values (or zeros) to collocation point coordinates. Three hidden layers of width 512, Tanh activation, Adam optimizer, same hyperparameter grid search.

methods.name: Data-driven DCON
methods.protocol_description: Data-driven Deep Compositional Operator Network trained on FEM-generated solutions. Used for comparison in ablation study.

methods.name: Data-driven GANO
methods.protocol_description: Data-driven Geometry-Aware Neural Operator (GANO) with geometry encoder, trained on FEM-generated solutions. Used for comparison in ablation study.
